info.name: CoinGecko Crypto Market Data Asset Platforms OHLCV API

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

params.name: aggregate
params.description: Aggregation period. For day timeframe (1). For hour timeframe (1, 4, 12). For minute timeframe (1, 5, 15).

params.name: before_timestamp
params.description: Return data before this UNIX timestamp

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of OHLCV data points to return (max 1000)

params.name: token
params.description: Which token to use for price (base or quote). Only applicable when currency is token.

items.docs: Get OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) candlestick chart data for a specific liquidity pool. Supports daily, hourly, and minutely timeframes with various aggregation periods.
